initial_pass_sensitivity.pass_description: Initial source-first reference and initial anonymized mapping before subsequent audited revisions.

rules.actor_wording: Literal comparison preserves recorded wording including surrounding whitespace. Normalized comparison strips/collapses whitespace and casefolds. Neither is a semantic entity-equivalence score.
rules.category_and_tag_normalization: Extract existing A–W category code; compare action tag lists as exact sets and first tags separately. No semantic retagging.
rules.field_missingness: Pairwise field denominators require comparable values on both sides. Missing/uncodable fields are excluded, never silently counted as matching.
rules.government_normalization: Only single interpretable country codes; explicit US→USA, SD→SDN, SS→SSD aliases. Multiple-country and prose cells remain incomparable.
rules.historical_review: Saved November 3 assessments remain dependent on the original Luna action and government; recomputing their subgroup counts is not new political-label coding.
rules.human_sentiment: The original human coding has one legacy sentiment field. No human three-dimension agreement is manufactured.
rules.legacy_rates: Prior 178/262 and 187-case rates are historical comparisons, not constraints on this fresh semantic mapping.
rules.no_action: Explicit NONE is a substantive choice. Missing/uninterpretable choices are not NONE. Shared explicit NONE counts as event-choice agreement.
rules.review_provenance: Model-assisted reference first selected unseen candidate answers, followed by anonymized mapping and a logged subset audit using anonymous answers. Initial and final passes are separately reported; not independent human ground truth.
rules.structural_failures: All four readable action choices can enter event-only metrics; invalid full-record status remains separately recorded.
rules.unique_reference_mask: single_action or explicit no_action reference, and interpretable choices from both coders. No correctness or old coder-specific selection flag controls inclusion.
rules.unit: One historical validation case; membership fixed at 266.
rules.unsupported_choices: Interpretable unsupported actions remain in the comparison as distinct X identities; they are not excluded as unmappable.
